summary: Main per-frame vehicle physics tick: snapshots raw controller bytes, maps inputs through sub_454DA0 into steering/throttle/brake commands, commits them to the vehicle input block, then runs steering damping and heading-limit clamps, tire/suspension force projection against the track center line, obstacle/collision avoidance (wheel-link walk, opponent proximity loop, grid-mode probes), lap/position state transitions, control-mode speed logic, per-wheel torque/brake distribution, and final gearbox dispatch. Gates on vehicle state mode, session type, gear-shift mode, pit state and opponent presence.

local_names.v283: snapshot word at this+0x7A (ABS flag + shift mode)
local_names.v263: probe object pointer stored at this+0xB4
local_names.v264: normalized steering error before sign application

operations.description: Snapshot raw control bytes: save dword this+0x72 (handbrake), dword this+0x76 (aid flags), word this+0x7A (ABS flag), byte this+0x7C (traction-control flag) into locals v281/v282/v283/v284 for the rest of the frame.
Gear-shift-mode gate: v261 = (dword_7CE910 != 0 and this+0x75 == 3); guard:5 (this+0x75 != 3) blocks the semi-auto shift path.

Controls-present gate: if byte this+0x70 (brake input raw) is zero, initialize all control outputs (steering 0, throttle 0, brake 1, offset 0, v319=-2) and clear flags v268/v259/v288/v284/v261, jumping to the commit stage.
Input processing: sub_454DA0(this+0x68 throttle raw, &steering, &throttle, &brake, &v323, &v324, &v319) maps raw controller values into per-frame vehicle commands.
Derive frame flags from global state words: v290 = pit-lane direction sign from dword_7CC184/dword_7CC1B0; v268 = dword_7CC1DC != 0; v259 = dword_7CC368 != 0; v288 = dword_7CC33C != 0.

Visual state change: if byte this+0x7C (TC flag) is set and the config object at this+0x1F00 has its controller flag at +0x344C set, force setup state (v291=1, v281=50463234, v283=514, clear v290) and call VisualStateChange(1, 0); otherwise VisualStateChange(0, 0).

Commit computed control outputs: this+0x8 = throttle blend v291, this+0x10 = brake blend v304, this+0x0 = steering v280, this+0x20 = offset v324; store v290 into this+0x2C and byte v268 into this+0x28 when changed; v289 = (this+0x1EF0 == -1) gates lap-state accumulation.

Session-type gates: this+0x34 (session type) == 6 (qualifying, guard:2) enables qualifying-specific steering, == 5 (race, guard:3) race-specific behavior, > 3 (active session, guard:4) permits lap-state transitions.

Pit-lane steering clamp: if v290 nonzero and matches session direction (v290>0 and type==6, or v290<0 and type==5) and flt_7CE8EC + this+0x38 > this+0x60, zero v290; if byte this+0x71 (clutch) is clear, also zero when the shift-mode byte is 1/2/3.

Commit backing/history values: store v9 into this+0x40, v12 into this+0x4C, v14 into this+0x54, v13 into this+0x48, previous this+0x10 into this+0x50, v10 into this+0x58; blend this+0x8 throttle using ratio this+0x1C50 * this+0x1C5C when the product is positive.

Pit-limit/HUD state machine on this+0x1D30: guard:7 (this+0x1D30 != 1) gates pit-limiter logic; state 1 with v259 clear becomes state 2 and calls HUDElementConfig(41, 2, blend) using weather-noise lookups flt_8AB274/flt_8AAE74 indexed by dword_8AAE70 (RW) with this+0x8 < 0.8 clearing state 2; state 0 with v259, this+0x1D34 != 0, this+0x1EF0 == 0 and this+0xD0 != 2 (guard:6) becomes state 1 and calls HUDElementConfig again.

Speed-based steering damping: start v269 = 1.0; if this+0x9C (damping distance) > 0, compute speed = sqrt of the this+0x15F0 object +0x64/+0x6C/+0x74 vector squared; scale factor v30 = 1 - this+0x9C (or a cos-based blend); apply this+0x0 *= v30.

Heading-limit clamp: if byte2 of v282 is set, Mat3x3MulVec(matrix at this+0x15F0+0x1C, vector at this+0x15F0+0x64, v308); if the projected heading exceeds 9 units and points backwards, v262 = atan2(-v308[0], -v309) * this+0x8C; when the sign matches v280, raise v269 to |v262| (capped at 1) and set this+0x0 = v280 * v269.
Wheel-state copy: if dword_7CE6D0 & 1, copy four strided blocks anchored at this+0x504 (stride 1124 bytes) moving wheel-state fields this+0x504/0x508/0x514/0x518.

Tire-contact aging sentinel: for four strided entries at this+0x690 (stride 1124 bytes), if the value exceeds 1148.16 write the sentinel dword (-687194767) to this+0x690 and the 4.5606 float to this+0x694.

Vehicle-state gates: tire contact aging mode *(*(this+0x1F00)+0x32E0)+0x78 != 2 (guard:0) keeps the contact patch valid; vehicle state mode *(this+0x1F00)+0x3450 == 4 (guard:1, starting grid) blocks the physics body update.

Collision-tree probe object: v37 = this+0x15F0, v38 = this+0xB4; read position v305/v306/v307 from the this+0x15F0 object at +0x4/+0xC/+0x14; if v38 is null or a state flag is set, sub_403640(dword_5EA2C0, &v305, v38) recreates the probe object, stores it to this+0xB4 and copies an 0x18-byte block to this+0xB8.

Tire-force projection: on the probe object v44 = this+0xB4, compute force v293 = v299*v48 + v47*(v46-v306) + v297*v45 from velocity fields this+0xB4:0x94/0x98/0x9C and direction fields this+0xB4:0xA4/0xA8/0xAC, and half-projection v294/v295/v296 against the forward vector this+0xB4:0x20/0x24/0x28 using the position delta read from this+0xB4:0x88.

Slip-ratio interpolation: pick the load-normalizing branch object at *(this+0xB4):0x10C or :0x110 by the sign of v293 (the divisor is the yaw-rate field at *(this+0xB4)+0x3C, with the equivalent +0x3C field on the +0x10C body-dynamics sub-object); clamp the ratio v54 to [0, 1]; interpolate the slip plane using sub-object fields 0x20/0x24/0x28 (forward) and 0x88/0x94/0x98/0x9C (velocity).
Velocity vector capture: v313/v314/v315 = *(double*)(this+0x15F0 + 0x64/+0x6C/+0x74) (the speed vector).

Contact-patch grip scaling: if the v283 byte is set, scale by (flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC)/2 * (this+0xAC - 1) + 1 when positive; recompute the speed magnitude from the this+0x15F0 object +0x64/+0x6C/+0x74 vector.

Speed/limit damping: when speed v59 is below v57 - 3, blend this+0x10 (brake blend) toward v60 through this+0x8 with smoothing for the v283 == 1 case and hard zeroing of this+0x8/0xC (as dword pairs) when the sign flips.

Wheel-link geometry walk: if the v283 byte == 2 and speed exceeds 14, walk a 25-link chain from *(this+0xB4):0x110 reading rigid-body fields 0x0/0x4/0x8/0x20/0x24/0x28/0x2C/0x30/0x110 of *(*(this+0xB4)+0x110); for each segment PlaneLineIntersectionRatio computes the nearest obstacle distance v292.

Brake-approach damping: v85 = 14 + v292 * 0.8 with heading-based adjustments built from the this+0xB4:0xA4/0xA8/0xAC direction fields; below the 13-unit band raise this+0x8 or brake this+0x10 via a 13-unit ramp.
Avoidance eligibility: if v284 (the byte snapshot of this+0x7C) is clear, skip the entire collision-avoidance block.
Lap/position init: if this+0x1EF0 == -1 (guard:8, no opponent/start-line state), call PositionLapStateUpdate(0, 4).

Race-state transform chain: if the track-state field in the this+0x1F00 object is 2/3/4, run ConditionalDelegateDispatch(this+0x1F00, &v310, v308), F_3DTransformWithMatrixMultiplication(&v300, &v316) and EulerToRotationMatrix(v308, v338).

Avoidance force vector: v275 = dot of the negated rotation-matrix rows with the position offset; v97 = dot of the rotated velocity (v313/v314/v315 from the this+0x15F0 object +0x64/+0x6C/+0x74); clamp v97 to >= 0.

Grid-mode avoidance (track state 4): if v97 exceeds flt_8ACFB4 clear the avoidance flag; validate the other-vehicle state then call RenderCallWithGuard(this+0x1F00, v329, v335) and CoordinateTransformWithOffset(v329, v335, v325); on the resulting flag, zero this+0x8/0xC/0x10/0x14.

Collision-distance probe: when dword_8ACFD4 == 2, read the start position from the this+0x15F0 object +0x4/+0xC/+0x14; SceneNodePositionGetter (gated by dword_8ACFD8 and dword_8AD078) computes the nearest approach v292 as a dot against the this+0xB4:0xA4/0xA8/0xAC direction; derive the approach margin into this+0x8/0x10.
Non-grid avoidance blend: v98 = (v275 + 0.5) * 0.5 - v97; drive this+0x8 toward v98 * 0.2 or brake this+0x10, otherwise hard-zero this+0x8/0xC/0x10/0x14.

Avoidance steering push-out: if this+0x138 (collision-offset accumulator) is zero, recreate it via sub_403640(dword_5EA2C0, &v310, 0) and store the projected distance; v279 = 2 * fabs(this+0x138) + 11.5; push the steering target out along the forward vector this+0xB4:0x20/0x24/0x28 scaled by this+0x138.

Opponent proximity loop: if dword_5C329C > 0, iterate opponents through dword_7C54F0; skip self using the this+0x1F00 object; F_3DVectorTransformBy33Matrix(matrix at this+0x15F0+0x1C, position at this+0x15F0+0x4, ...) projects each opponent; when within -3..0 m ahead raise this+0x8 or brake this+0x10 via a 5-unit ramp, otherwise zero this+0x8..0x14.

Steering-target chain walk: v132 = force/velocity dot, v279 = v132 * 0.29 + 3; walk the this+0xB4 link chain following *(this+0xB4):0x110, reading the this+0xB4:0x94/0x98/0x9C target fields and the chained sub-object angular fields *(*(this+0xB4)+0x110):0xA4/0xA8/0xAC; interpolate the track-center target v285/v286/v287.

Steering error: v145 = atan2(-(this+0x15F0 object +0x5C), -(this+0x15F0 object +0x2C)) - atan2(v322 + v287 - v307, v308), wrapped to [-pi, pi]; v264 = v145 * this+0x8C clamped to [-1, 1]; then negate by the heading dot product.
Steering apply: if byte2 of v282 == 3, write this+0x0 = v264 (direct heading lock).

Steering gain scaling: if dword_7CE6D0 & 1, scale the wheel-state blocks this+0x504/0x508 (stride 1124 bytes) by 1.0399/1.0898 and the this+0x5B8 block (stride 1124 bytes) by +700/+1477 depending on the shift-mode byte.
Steering rate limit: if dword_7CE6D0 < 2, v171 = (9.5 or 6.5) * this+0x8C * degrees-to-radians limited to v269; when v280 and v264 agree in sign, write this+0x0 = v280 * max(v171, |v264|).
Steering smoothing (manual shift mode): v156 = fabs(this+0x0 - this+0xA4) * this+0x68; ramp this+0xA4 toward this+0x0 with 10x/20x gains and record the history pair into this+0x0/0x4 and this+0xA8.
Steering blend fallback: on the error-sign flag this+0x0 = v168 + v264 with a lower clamp of -1; otherwise this+0x0 = v169 + v264 with an upper clamp of +1.
State-block zeroing: zero twelve dwords this+0xEC through this+0x118 (lap/sector accumulators and impulse slots).

Wall/kerb collision response: if the this+0x15F0 object +0x3C value > 0.5 and the this+0x1F00 object +0x4064 damage gate is clear, call RenderCallWithGuard and CoordinateTransformWithOffset on the vehicle position; ensure the collision probe this+0x11C via sub_403640(dword_5EA2C0, ...); a heading mismatch within +-0.31416 rad applies a -2000 impulse to this+0xEC/0xF4/0xFC, otherwise a 1100/19000 impulse to this+0x104/0x10C/0x114; reads probe fields *(this+0x11C) 0x0/0x4/0x8/0x20/0x24/0x28/0x2C/0x30/0xA4/0xA8/0xAC/0x110 (including the wheel-force sub-object at *(*(this+0x11C)+0x110):0x0/+0x8).

Lap-transition accumulator (start line): gated by the active-session condition (this+0x34 > 3 or flt_7CE8C8 + this+0x38 < this+0x60); if this+0x1EF0 == -1 (guard:8) and v289, accumulate this+0x1EFC += v291 * this+0x68 and call PositionLapStateUpdate(0, 4) when the accumulator crosses 1.0.

Sector/position transitions: with this+0x1EF8 clear, compare the this+0x1C5C distance against the this+0x1C84/0x1C8C/0x1C94 thresholds; state 1 with low throttle calls PositionLapStateUpdate(0, 4); higher states run BoundingVolumeHierarchyTraversalFilter(this, this+0x140/0x148) gated by this+0x1D30 != 1 (guard:7) and the this+0x1EAC bound, then PositionLapStateUpdate(+1, 4).

Start-grid launch: accumulate this+0x1EFC += v304 * this+0x68 while this+0x1EF8 is clear; on crossing 1.0 call PositionLapStateUpdate(-1, 4); otherwise if throttle v291 >= 0.2 and this+0x1C5C > this+0x1C8C, call PositionLapStateUpdate(1, 4).

Position-change state machine: if v319 >= -1 and v319 != this+0x30, call PositionLapStateUpdate(v319, 1) and store this+0x30 = v319; the grid-position delta v290 (from dword_7CC1B8 / dword_7CC1BC != 89) adjusts this+0x1EF4 bounded by this+0x1EAC and calls PositionLapStateUpdate(+1 or -1, 0); pit-state v268 triggers PositionLapStateUpdate(0, 1) and this+0x30 = 0.

Per-object control output: write through the this+0x1630 object (field 0x0) = this+0x163C * this+0x0 + this+0x1634, and the this+0x1644 object (field 0x0) = this+0x1650 * this+0x0 + this+0x1648; zero this+0x170/0x174.

Aero/brake blend: when LOBYTE(v281) is set and v288 is clear, average the geometry fields this+0x10FC/0xC98 (plus this+0x834/0x3D0 for state 2) selected by this+0x1E14; blend this+0x8 with the this+0x150/0x158 and this+0x160 or this+0x168 coefficients; record the delta to this+0x170.

Control-mode speed logic: v218 = this+0x1D30; mode 0 computes this+0x20/0x24 from this+0x1C84/0x1C8C/0x1C5C and clamps the 0.1..0.9 band; mode 1 raises this+0x24 and uses this+0x1D3C/0x1D44 to brake this+0x8; mode 2 with this+0x1EF0 == 1 (guard:9) and this+0x1C5C > this+0x1E38 computes v223 from the geometry fields this+0x8FC/0xA14/0x82C/0x498/0x5B0/0x3C8/0x11C4/0x12DC/0x10F4/0xD60/0xE78/0xC90 and writes this+0x20; the low-speed gate zeroes this+0x20/0x24.
Control override: v226 = this+0xD0 (vehicle state mode, guard:6); state 1 clears itself when this+0x1EF0 is set and this+0x1D30 != 1; otherwise force this+0x20 = 0 and this+0x24 = 1.
Torque distribution: v227 = this+0x155C * this+0x10; split v300 = (1 - this+0x1564) * v227, v301 = v300, v302 = v227 * this+0x1564, v303 = v302.

Yaw-based differential lock: if byte2 of v281 is set, build the heading from the this+0x15F0 matrix rows (+0x1C/+0x24/+0x34/+0x3C/+0x44/+0x4C/+0x54/+0x5C/+0x64/+0x6C/+0x74/+0x7C/+0x84/+0x8C); when the deviation exceeds 3 and points backwards, v231 = atan2(...) - this+0x94 * this+0x0 - (matrix dot) * 0.1; redistribute v300..v303 by the clamped v237 and clamp each wheel to [0, 1]; raise this+0x8 to min(fabs(v237) * 1.75, 0.175).
Brake bias: v233 = v323 * this+0x1554; add the bias term to the rear-wheel torque outputs v302/v303.

Per-wheel brake blend: if byte1 of v281 is set and this+0x178 is set, loop four wheels anchored at this+0x3D0 (stride 1124 bytes) blending by this+0x17C/0x184 and this+0x18C; otherwise take the minimum wheel value and scale all four wheels by this+0x18C or this+0x194.

Axle-presence gating: if the this+0x1F00 object axle-state fields at +0x834/+0x874/+0x95C/+0x99C/+0xA84/+0xAC4/+0xBAC/+0xBEC are absent, zero the corresponding front or rear torque outputs v300/v301/v302/v303.

Per-wheel torque-split accumulation: for wheels 0..3 accumulate the per-wheel blocks using the v300..v303 torque split against strided accumulator fields (offsets not individually enumerated), then Gearbox(this, HIBYTE(v281), v282) finalizes gear selection from the drivetrain fields this+0x1554/0x155C/0x1564.

clean_pseudocode: snapshot raw control bytes this[0x72/0x76/0x7A/0x7C] into locals;
if this[0x70] == 0: zero control outputs, clear flags, jump to commit;
gate on session type this[0x34] (5 race, 6 qualifying, >3 active) and vehicle mode this[0x1F00]+0x3450 == 4 (grid);
run steering damping / heading-limit clamps and tire-suspension force projection against the track center line;
run obstacle avoidance: wheel-link walk, opponent proximity loop, grid-mode probes;
run lap/position state machine with PositionLapStateUpdate;
run control-mode speed logic and per-wheel torque/brake distribution;
Gearbox(this, shiftmode, aidflags) at the end.

Globals 0x007CA590 (ppvOut) and 0x008ACEE0 (dword_8ACEE0) are read per the fact table but have no visible use site in the .c.
Tire-block fields *(*(this+0x1F00)+0x32E0)+0x7C (temperature accumulation) and +0x84 (wear scalar) are read per the fact table but not visible in the .c.

Gearbox state pointer *(this+0x1F00)+0x32E0 and the brake-disc/load/slip fields this+0x5BC, +0x670, +0x6D8/+0x6DC/+0x6E0/+0x6E4/+0x6E8/+0x6EC are read per the fact table but not visible in the .c (likely inside the Gearbox callee or inlined wheel/tire helpers).

The 0x18-byte qmemcpy to this+0xB8 and the collision-probe copy to this+0x120 are not enumerated among the packet fields.

BoundingVolumeHierarchyTraversalFilter thresholds come from an unenumerated per-state control-point table in the this+0x1F00 region and the external dword_5C7530; both are outside the packet evidence set.
The exact object identity behind the slip-interpolation reads at *(*(this+0xB4)+0x10C) vs *(*(this+0xB4)+0x110) is ambiguous because the two sign branches of v293 pick different chain objects.
